nom: DRMTLGY Needle-less Growth Factor Firming and Lifting Serum

segments.dry: A reviewer with sensitive dry skin reports no issues and a smooth, hydrated feel after use.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including some with rosacea or perioral dermatitis, mostly report no irritation or redness, though one notes purging with cystic bumps and another avoids the serum on a dermatitis patch.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination (including former oily, now combination, and combo/acne-prone/hormonal) skin describe the serum as lightweight and well absorbed with visible improvement in texture and tone.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing themselves as mature, in their 50s to 70s, report firmer, plumper skin and reduced fine lines and sagging, though one mature reviewer found it overpriced with no visible improvement.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers using it for fine lines, wrinkles, sagging, and marionette lines report visible smoothing, plumping, and firming within two to eight weeks; two reviewers report no improvement at all after weeks or months of use.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers report the serum feels hydrating and plumping, with skin described as more hydrated and less prone to fine-line dryness soon after application.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea or reactive redness generally report no worsening or irritation, with one exception where a perioral dermatitis patch reacted.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer switching from retinol found this serum non-irritating and less drying, using it as a gentler alternative; another reports her skin peels less when paired with retinol.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports reduced discoloration after about a month of use.
concerns.blemishes: The serum is described by one reviewer as acne-friendly, but another reports a purging episode with cystic nodules shortly after starting.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with a history of oily skin now finds the serum light and easily absorbed with no greasy residue; another separately confirms no greasy film.

aspects.libelle: Layers well under makeup and sunscreen

extraits.texte: I truly wanted to love this after the reviews. I have mature early 50s skin. I cannot justify paying this much for a product that I use twice a day and does NOT last long. It is much more expensive than a few other brands that deliver the same or better results. Causing me ti go back to what is more affordable and JUST as EFFECTIVE! So, my opinion is to give the less expensive face serums a try and you will see that more expensive does not mean better quality or delivers what it claims. Best if luck!

I absolutely love the Needles Growth Factor Serum. At first, I was a bit concerned because I have very sensitive skin and suffer from rosacea but the serum is actually very gentle and didn't cause any redness. I've been using it for about a month and I can already seen how much my skin has improved! And I'm not the only one! My daughter, who lives in Italy and hadn't seen in person since May, was very impressed with my skin. She asked if I had changed something in my routine because my skin looks firmer than before! At 59 my biggest issues is the loss of firmness especially in my chin area. This serum is really making a difference. I use it along with the needless serum and the results are real! Couldn't be happier!

extraits.titre: Transformed my skin with Peptide Night Cream
extraits.texte: I've only used it for 2 weeks, but this and the Peptide Night Cream have totally transformed my skin!! I have sensitive, combo, acne prone and hormonal skin. I'm so glad I found this line. I can't wait to try other things!

I've only been using this serum for the past two weeks, so this is a first impressions type of review. I have rosacea and a small patch of perioral dermatitis. The rosacea does not react to the serum, the dermatitis does, so I now avoid that area. The rest of the face/neck and chest feel lovely. It sinks in well and leaves no greasy finish or film. I can't talk about anti aging benefits just yet, only about the appearance of the skin. So far I will repurchase

From the first day I used this growth serum, I knew it was working. The very next day I woke up with "purging acne"(even a couple of cystic nodules). I know this is to be expected for some of us and it doesn't last forever. I have very sensitive skin and I am 65, so I haven't has skin turnover this fast since I was a teenager (although, I never had acne then, just an occasional blemish). I splurged on this item and do believe this is outperforming my Ordinary growth serum. Worth the price, if you can be patient through a potential breakout.

I've only been using this product for 10 days and I can already see a difference. The smooth texture and brightness of my skin is noticeable. The serum is light and instantly gives the skin a glow. I have sensitive dry skin and have not had any issues with my skin. Don't hesitate, just give it a try.!

I wanted to love this and was hoping for great results, but after using this morning and evening for almost 2 months, I have seen no improvement on my face and neck. I will not be purchasing another bottle. This is too expensive to see no improvement.
